blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Online semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables open-vocabulary scene understanding from streaming observations. However, existing methods recover geometric context missing from image-derived semantic features using an additionally learned 3D network, incurring extra training and runtime overhead. We observe that such geometric-semantic evidence may already exist in the agent's observation history and can be retrieved rather than learned. Based on this insight, we introduce RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting), a lightweight, training-free mechanism that treats past observations as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior. RecallGS follows a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: CLIP retrieves relevant observations, alpha-compositing weights identify geometrically supported views, and aggregate their semantic features over each Gaussian's rendered footprint. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS achieves strong semantic segmentation performance at 2.48 FPS, demonstrating that geometric-semantic context can be effectively recovered from observation history without an additional learned 3D branch.
blocks.zh: 在线语义学 3D 高斯平板电脑(3DGS) 能够从流体观测中实现开放-vocabulary场景理解. 然而,现有方法利用另外学习的三维网络,恢复图像衍生语义特征中缺失的几何上下文,进行额外培训和运行时间管理。 我们观察到,这种几何语义证据可能已经存在于代理人的观测史上,可以检索而不是学习. 基于这种洞察力,我们引入了RecallGS(Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splateting),这是一种轻量级,无训练的机制,将过去的观测作为非参数几何-语义前置. 召回GS采用召回地面引信管道: CLIP检索相关的观测,α-集成权重识别几何支持的视图,并在每个高斯人得到的足迹上汇总其语义特征. 在ScanNet和ScanNet++上,RecallGS在2.48 FPS上实现强语义分解性能,表明几何语义上下文可以在没有额外学习到的3D分支的情况下从观测历史中有效恢复.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient explicit representation for real-time novel-view synthesis [ 11 ] . Recent works extend 3DGS with open-vocabulary semantics by distilling vision-language features into Gaussians, either through rendering-based supervision [ 19 , 22 , 30 ] or direct 3D feature lifting and referring [ 26 , 12 ] . This paradigm has further expanded to online embodied settings, using either language-aware 3DGS-SLAM [ 9 , 31 ] or generalizable feed-forward reconstruction [ 14 ] , alongside online 3D instance segmentation methods that fuse 2D foundation-model predictions into persistent 3D representations [ 27 , 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 3D Gaussian Splateting(3DGS)为实时小说-视觉合成提供了高效的清晰表现[11]. 近期的作品通过将视觉语言特征蒸馏到高斯人体内,或者通过渲染式监督[19,22,30],或者直接3D特征提升和引用[26,12],将3DGS与开放-vobulary语义学相扩展. 这一范式进一步扩展至在线内含设置,使用语言意识的3DGS-SLAM[9,31]或通用的feed-forward重建[14],同时使用在线的3D实例分解方法,将2D基础模型预测纳入持续的3D表示[27,24].

blocks.en: Despite this progress, existing online semantic 3DGS pipelines recover the geometric context missing from image-derived language features through an additional learned 3D branch, rather than directly reusing geometric-semantic evidence from past observations. EmbodiedSplat [ 14 ] , for instance, complements its 2D CLIP features [ 21 ] with geometry-aware 3D features produced by passing the local Gaussian point cloud through a sparse 3D U-Net [ 6 ] equipped with a temporal memory adapter [ 28 ] . This 3D branch, however, must be trained on large-scale posed 3D indoor scene data, which is costly to collect and introduces additional GPU-memory consumption and latency that directly reduce the online reconstruction speed. EmbodiedSplat-fast removes the 3D U-Net and memory adapter, increasing throughput from 0.75 FPS to 5.18 FPS at the cost of geometric-semantic context. This highlights the training and inference overhead of recovering explicit 3D context through an additional learned branch. We ask whether such context must be learned at all, or can instead be recovered from the agent’s observation history.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这一进展,但现有的在线语义3DGS管道通过额外的学习到的3D分支恢复了图像衍生语言特征中缺失的几何语境,而不是直接重新使用过去观测得到的几何语义证据. 例如,EmbodySplate [14], 补充其2D CLIP特征[21],通过一个零星的3D U-Net[6],并配备了时间记忆适配器[28],通过当地高斯点云传递产生的几何感知3D特征. 然而,这个3D分支必须接受大规模设置3D室内场景数据的培训,收集并引入更多直接降低在线重建速度的GPU-记忆消耗和耐久性成本高昂. EmbodySplat-fast移除了3D U-Net和内存适配器,以几何语境为代价将吞吐量从0.75 FPS增加到5.18 FPS. 这突出表明了通过一个额外的知识分支恢复明确的立体环境的培训和推断间接费用。 我们问,是否必须了解这种背景,还是可以从代理人的观察历史中恢复。

blocks.en:
We observe that this trade-off is a consequence of treating each observation independently. An embodied agent operates in a persistent environment: a Gaussian that is geometrically or semantically ambiguous from the current viewpoint may correspond to a physical surface already observed earlier under a more favorable viewpoint, illumination, or occlusion pattern. This suggests that part of the geometric prior EmbodiedSplat’s 3D branch must learn from parameters could instead be recovered from the agent’s own trajectory, treating its accumulated observation history as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior queried on demand rather than compressed once and discarded. However, effectively reusing past observations introduces several challenges. First, semantic similarity does not imply physical correspondence: a CLIP-based retrieval system [ 21 ] may return frames containing a visually similar object-another chair, table, or door-at an entirely different location. Second, a Gaussian may project inside a historical image but still be occluded by closer geometry. Sampling the projected pixel would then transfer features from the occluder rather than from the queried surface.
Finally, exhaustively verifying every historical camera against every incoming frame would itself undermine the efficiency this history is meant to provide, as a long-running agent may accumulate hundreds to thousands of observations. The problem is therefore not retrieval of similar-looking memories, but memory routing: determining, without prior semantic knowledge of the current Gaussians, which past observations should be allowed to influence each one.
blocks.zh:
我们认为,这种权衡是独立对待每一项观察的结果。 一个内含的物剂在持久性环境中运作:从当前观点看,一个几何或模棱两可的高斯人可能与先前在更有利的观点、照明或隔离模式下观察到的物理表面相对应。 这表明,先前的EmbodySplat的3D分支必须从参数中学习,而可以从代理商自己的轨迹中回收一部分,将其累积的观测历史视为一个非参数的几何-语义,事先按要求询问,而不是一次压缩和丢弃。 然而,有效利用过去的意见带来了若干挑战。 首先,语义上的相似性并不意味着物理通信:一个基于CLIP的检索系统[21]可以返回包含一个视觉上相似的对象-另一个椅子,桌子,或者在完全不同的位置的门上. 第二,高斯人可能在历史图像内投影,但仍被更接近的几何学所占据. 将投影像素取样后,会从闭路器而不是从被询问的表面转移特征。
最后,彻底核实每一台历史相机与每台接收到的相机本身将损害这一历史要提供的效率,因为一个长期存在的代理人可能积累数百至数千个观测数据。 因此,问题不在于检索类似外观的记忆,而在于记忆的路由:在没有事先对当前高斯人语义学知识的情况下,确定哪些过去观测应允许影响每一个.

blocks.en: To this end, we propose RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall), a lightweight mechanism requiring no additional training that treats an agent’s observation history as a queryable source of geometric-semantic evidence, routed to the current Gaussians through a recall–ground–replay pipeline. Our contributions are threefold: (1) semantic recall, a cheap CLIP-based retrieval stage that narrows an unbounded observation history to a small candidate pool of appearance-plausible frames; (2) geometric grounding, which reranks these candidates using alpha-compositing weights to identify views that geometrically support the current Gaussians; and (3) compositing fusion, which reuses the same alpha-compositing weights to aggregate historical features over each Gaussian’s full rendered footprint. Our experiments show that each component contributes independently to semantic accuracy, and that their combination enables effective geometric-semantic reasoning from observation history while maintaining efficient online inference
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提出“重回(Geometery-Grounded Recall) ” (RecallGS),这是一种不需要额外训练的轻量级机制,它把特工的观测历史作为可查询的几何语义证据来源,通过重回-地面-重回式管道输送到目前的高斯人。 我们的贡献有三个方面:(1) 语义召回,一个廉价的基于CLIP的检索阶段,将一个无限制的观测历史缩小到一个小候选的外观-可信框架库;(2) 几何定位,用α组合的权重来重新排列这些候选者,以识别几何学支持当前高斯人的观点;(3) 复合核聚变,再利用相同的α组合权重,在每一个高斯人的完整足迹上积累历史特征。 我们的实验表明,每个元件对语义准确性都有独立的贡献,它们的结合使得从观测历史中有效的几何语义推理能够同时保持高效的在线推论.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We show that an agent’s observation history can serve as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior, providing complementary semantic evidence without additional 3D training or per-scene optimization. • We propose RecallGS , a training-free recall-ground-fuse framework that efficiently retrieves relevant past observations, grounds them against the current geometry, and fuses their semantic evidence into the current Gaussians. • We validate the contribution of each component and show that exploiting observation history consistently improves online semantic 3DGS while maintaining efficient inference.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 我们显示,代理人的观测历史可以作为非参数几何-语义学的前身,提供补充语义学证据而无需额外的3D训练或每场优化. • 支助 我们提议使用无培训的召回-地面-引信框架(RecallGS),有效地检索过去的相关观测数据,使其与目前的几何数据相对照,并将其语义证据融入目前的高斯人。 我们验证每个部分的贡献,并表明利用观测历史不断改进在线语义3DGS,同时保持有效的推论.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Language-Embedded Gaussian Splatting
blocks.zh: 2.1 高斯语拼音

blocks.en:
Building on 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 11 ] , one line of work embeds
open-vocabulary semantics onto Gaussians via per-scene optimization, either by
distilling 2D vision-language features through differentiable rendering
supervision [ 19 , 22 , 30 ] or
by directly associating semantic features with 3D structure through clustering,
feature lifting, or compact Gaussian-level representations [ 26 , 12 , 16 , 5 , 1 , 20 , 23 ] . These methods establish 3DGS as an effective carrier of language features and improve their spatial consistency, instance awareness, or representation efficiency. However, most construct semantic fields specifically for each scene, which limits their applicability when observations arrive continuously.

blocks.en:
To remove scene-specific optimization, a class of feed-forward methods predicts 3D Gaussian representations directly from input images without per-scene training. This paradigm was established by geometric backbones such as pixelSplat [ 2 ] and MVSplat [ 4 ] , which regress RGB Gaussians from sparse image pairs. Building on this feed-forward formulation, subsequent work adds an open-vocabulary semantic branch: LSM [ 8 ] jointly regresses geometry, appearance, and semantics from unposed image pairs by lifting a pre-trained 2D language-based segmentation model into a 3D-consistent feature field decoded into semantic Gaussians, SLGaussian [ 3 ] targets the sparse-view regime with a multi-view language memory bank that maps high-dimensional CLIP features to compact per-object IDs for fast open-vocabulary querying, and SemanticSplat [ 17 ] further
improves language-aware feed-forward reconstruction by fusing SAM [ 13 ] and CLIP-LSeg [ 15 ] features into a cost-volume representation for cross-view semantic aggregation. These approaches avoid per-scene semantic optimization and generalize across scenes, but still operate on a fixed, small set of input views rather than maintaining a persistent semantic representation under a streaming observation sequence.
blocks.zh:
为了去除场景特有的优化,一班的向导方法直接从输入图像中预测3D Gaussian的表示,而不进行每个场景的训练. 这个范式是由几何主干线如像素Splate[2]和MVSplate[4]所建立,这些主干线使RGB高斯人从稀疏的图像配对中倒退. 基于这个feed-forward配方,随后的工作增加了一个开放的vocabulary语义分支:LSM [8]通过将一个预先训练的基于2D语言的分区模型提升到3D兼容的特征域解码为语义高斯语,联合将几何,外观和语义从未布置的图像对递归,SLGussian [3] 以多视图语言记忆库为对象,将高维的CLIP特征映射到紧凑的每个对象的ID中,用于快速的开放语义查询,SemamticSplate [17] 进一步
通过将 SAM [13] 和 CLIP-LSeg [15] 特性装入跨视图语义集成的成本-量表示,改善语言-感知信息前置重建。 这些方法避免了单场语义优化和跨场景的概括,但仍在固定的,小的一组输入视图上运行,而不是在流线式观测序列下保持持续的语义表现.

blocks.en: 2.2 Online Gaussian Splatting Reconstruction and Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.2 在线高斯白板重建和分块

blocks.en:
A separate line of work extends 3DGS to the online setting required by embodied perception. Within visual SLAM, SplaTAM [ 10 ] and Gaussian Splatting SLAM [ 18 ] use explicit Gaussians for incremental tracking, mapping, and rendering, demonstrating that 3DGS can serve as a persistent scene representation under streaming observations. Building on this formulation, Online-LangSplat [ 9 ] and EA3D [ 31 ] inject language or foundation-model features into the online reconstruction loop. Online-LangSplat’s language module itself runs in milliseconds, but the overall SLAM-GS pipeline remains bottlenecked by per-frame camera-pose optimization, yielding well under 2 FPS end-to-end; EA3D similarly
relies on a recurrent joint optimization module to align geometric and semantic features, at a comparable throughput cost. In parallel, online 3D instance segmentation methods incrementally fuse 2D foundation-model predictions into temporally consistent 3D instances [ 27 , 24 ] , building on adapter-based caching mechanisms that aggregate RGB-D features frame-by-frame to endow otherwise-offline backbones with temporal learning ability [ 28 ] ; these methods, however, operate on
point-based representations rather than a differentiable and renderable Gaussian semantic field.
blocks.zh:
单独的一行工作将3DGS延伸至体现感知所需要的在线设置. 在视觉SLAM中,SplaTAM [10] 和高斯镀版SLAM [18] 使用明确的高斯人来进行递增跟踪,绘图,以及渲染,表明3DGS可以在流线观测下作为持续的场景表现. 在此基础上,Online-LangSplate[9]和EA3D[31]将语言或基础模型特征注入在线重建循环. Online-LangSpla特的语言模块本身以毫秒的速度运行,但整个SLAM-GS管道仍然受到每帧相机的优化的瓶颈,在2个FPS端对端下产生;EA3D类似
依靠一个经常性的联合优化模块,以可比的吞吐量成本来调整几何和语义特征. 同时,在线三维实例分解方法将二维基础模型增导为时间上一致的三维实例预测[27,24],以适配器的缓存机制为基础,将RGB-D特征逐帧汇总,将具有时间学习能力的其他离线主干线赋予[28];然而,这些方法仍在运行。

blocks.en:
Closest to our setting are online, generalizable feed-forward pipelines that
avoid per-scene optimization entirely. FreeSplat++ [ 25 ] targets efficient whole-scene indoor reconstruction from long image sequences, using a low-cost cross-view aggregation module and a pixel-wise triplet fusion strategy to incrementally merge overlapping Gaussian primitives across views, together with a weighted floater-removal step that exploits the accumulated blending weights from this fusion. EmbodiedSplat [ 14 ] extends this backbone with open-vocabulary semantics through a sparse CLIP codebook and a learned 3D U-Net branch that injects geometric context into image-derived semantic features. This improves geometric-semantic awareness but requires additional 3D training and incurs non-negligible inference overhead. In contrast, we recover complementary geometric-semantic evidence directly from the agent’s own observation history and route it to the current Gaussians through a lightweight recall-ground-fuse mechanism without an additional learned 3D semantic branch.
blocks.zh:
离我们最近的是在线的 通用的输油管
避免完全优化每个场景。 FreeSplag+ [25] 瞄准从长图像序列中高效的全景室内重建,使用低成本的交叉视图聚合模块和像素偏转的三聚体聚变策略,逐渐将跨视线的重叠的高斯原始人融合在一起,同时采用加权浮体清除步骤,利用这种聚变中累积的混合重量. EmbodySplate [14]通过一个稀疏的CLIP编码本和一个向图像衍生的语义特征注入几何上下文的学习型的3D U-Net分支,将这个主干扩展为开放-vocabulary语义. 这提高了几何语义意识,但需要额外的三维培训,并产生不可忽略的推论费。 相比之下,我们直接从代理人自己的观测史中恢复补充的几何语义学证据,并通过一个轻量级的召回-地面-引信机制将其引向现在的高斯人,而没有额外的学识的三维语义学分支.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig 1 , RecallGS equips a lightweight online semantic mapping pipeline with episodic memory. For each incoming observation, we retrieve relevant past views, verify their geometric compatibility with the current scene, and reuse their semantic evidence to refine the current representation. This enables the model to exploit previously observed information while preserving an efficient online pipeline.

blocks.en: Dataset: We follow the same dataset and evaluation setup as EmbodiedSplat [ 14 ] . Specifically, we evaluate on the indoor ScanNet [ 7 ] and ScanNet++ [ 29 ] benchmarks using the same preprocessed test scenes and ground-truth semantic annotations provided by the official EmbodiedSplat implementation. For ScanNet, we report 3D semantic segmentation under the 10, 15, and 19 class evaluation protocols, while ScanNet++ is evaluated under the 20-class setting. Unless otherwise stated, all dataset preprocessing, scene splits, and evaluation protocols are kept identical to EmbodiedSplat to ensure direct comparability.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare RecallGS against representative open-vocabulary semantic 3DGS methods, including OpenGaussian [ 26 ] , Occam’s LGS [ 5 ] , Dr.Splat [ 12 ] , and InstanceGaussian [ 16 ] , as well as both EmbodiedSplat and EmbodiedSplat-fast [ 14 ] . Among them, EmbodiedSplat is the most relevant reference, as it augments the feed-forward reconstruction backbone with an additional geometry-aware 3D semantic branch, while EmbodiedSplat-fast removes this branch and relies only on the lightweight 2D semantic pathway. Since RecallGS is built upon EmbodiedSplat-fast, we use it as the primary baseline to isolate the benefit of historical semantic replay, while comparison with the full EmbodiedSplat evaluates whether historical evidence can recover geometry-aware semantic context without the additional 3D U-Net.
blocks.zh: 基线。 包括OpenGausian [26]、Occam的LGS [5]、Splat博士 [12] 、以及EctoryGausian [16], 以及EmbodySplat和EmbodySplat-fast [14]。 其中,EmformSplat是最为相关的参考文献,因为它用额外的几何感知3D语义分支来增强feed-forward重建主干线,而EmformSplat-fast则去除这个分支,仅依赖于轻量级2D语义路径. 由于RecallGS是建立在EmfectSplat-fast上,所以我们用它作为主要基线来隔离历史语义重播的好处,而与全EmfectSplat的比较则评价历史证据能否在没有额外3D U-Net的情况下恢复几何感知语义上下文.

These results indicate that geometrically grounded historical replay provides complementary evidence that stabilizes semantic predictions across viewpoints and improves the consistency of the reconstructed semantic field.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We propose RecallGS, a lightweight mechanism requiring no additional training that recasts an embodied agent’s observation history as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior via a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: retrieving plausible historical frames, verifying their geometric support through alpha-compositing responsibility, and fusing only this verified evidence into the current Gaussians. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS narrows the gap to EmbodiedSplat’s full 3D branch with higher speed than the full model.
blocks.zh: 我们建议使用轻量级机制RecallGS, 无需额外训练, 无需将一个内含物的观测历史改编为非参数的几何-语义, 之前通过回溯-地面-引信管道: 检索可信的历史框架, 通过α-集成责任验证它们的几何支持, 在ScanNet和ScanNet++上,RecallGS将差距缩小到EmpharmedSplact的全3D分支,速度高于全模型.

blocks.en: We observed that RecallGS’s quality is bounded by the past observations it relies on, offering limited benefit when historical views are sparse or low-quality and additionally, grounding rasterizes only the current local Gaussians, so occluders in the global map are not modeled and visibility may be overestimated. Future work may extend retrieval with a certainty or assessment gate that evaluates the reliability of a recalled observation, for instance based on viewpoint quality, illumination, or depth confidence, before allowing it to influence the current Gaussians.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到,“召回”系统的质量取决于它所依赖的过去观测结果,在历史观点稀少或质量低下的情况下,提供的好处有限,此外,地面光栅也只能是目前当地高斯人,因此全球地图上的隐蔽者不会被模拟,可见度可能被高估。 未来工作可能扩大检索范围,提供确定性或评估门,评价被回顾的观察的可靠性,例如,基于观点质量、照明或深度信心,然后才能影响目前的高斯人。
